Usage: actual budgets [options] [command]

Manage budgets

Options:
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  list                         List all available budgets
  download [options] <syncId>  Download a budget by sync ID
  months                       List available budget months
  month <month>                Get budget data for a specific month (YYYY-MM)
  set-amount [options]         Set budget amount for a category in a month
  set-carryover [options]      Enable/disable carryover for a category
  hold-next-month [options]    Hold budget amount for next month
  reset-hold [options]         Reset budget hold for a month
  help [command]               display help for command
